summary: Teaches adding k6 tests with thresholds to GitHub Actions/GitLab CI and streaming results to Grafana Cloud k6.

needs.description: Grafana Cloud k6 app (/a/k6-app) with Settings pages (stack-api-token, api-token, stack-id) and at least one project with a visible Project id.
needs.evidence: stream-results-cloud: navigate /a/k6-app/settings, /a/k6-app/projects "Open a project, copy Project id"

needs.description: k6 installed locally plus a k6 test script with thresholds (test.js); learner edits and runs it in a terminal.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "k6 installed on your machine", "A k6 test script with thresholds"

needs.description: GitHub Actions or GitLab CI repository where the learner adds workflow YAML and CI secrets (K6_CLOUD_TOKEN, K6_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID, K6_CLOUD_STACK_ID).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Access to a CI/CD platform"; stream-results-cloud secrets text

needs.description: A reachable HTTP target (BASE_URL, e.g. staging.example.com) for the test script.

reviewNotes: Most steps are terminal/CI instructions with no UI selectors; only stream-results-cloud is UI-testable (needs /a/k6-app). Not verifiable by browser E2E.
